Scenario fixture: focus-not-removed-by-script

Each target element has a stable id of the form fnrs_case_NN. The rule never fails: an inline focus handler that calls blur() is asked about.

A. FAIL and CANTTELL — an inline focus handler calls blur()

01 — FAIL: a link removes focus from itself (WCAG F55's example)
Offers
02 — FAIL: a read-only field removes focus from itself with a bare blur()
03 — CANTTELL: blur() among other code
07 — CANTTELL: an element outside the tab order removes focus from itself
Panel

B. NOT APPLICABLE

04 — NOT APPLICABLE: an onfocus handler that does not call blur()
Help
05 — NOT APPLICABLE: the element cannot take focus, so its handler never runs
Label
06 — NOT APPLICABLE: the element is not rendered
Old link
